name: hex-tally
title: Hexagon tally
description: A unit chart of hexagons fills in beside a metric card that counts up.

props.name: link
props.doc: Small link at the card top right.

props.name: from
props.doc: The headline total at the first frame.

props.name: total
props.doc: The headline total when the count lands.

props.name: segments
props.doc: The four segments, in the legend order.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: Seconds to hold on the finished card after the last hexagon.

props.name: settleSeconds
props.doc: How long the card takes to settle (the push decays by about 9% of what is left each frame; this scales it).
